name: Haven Street
desc1: True to its name, Haven Street has been decorated with white marble
desc2: statues depicting angels and other religious icons.  The temple of
desc3: Arlysia is both beautiful and excessive in its display of holiness.
desc4: Many of the statues seem to have been placed recently, as if they were
desc5: hoping to ward off evil with quantity.  To the east is the local Guild
desc6: House, and to the west is the temple entrance.
